data.name: M_WitnessModeNotice
data.value: Ordinary mode draws locally immediately, works offline, and saves a locally replayable proof. When online, new proofs are submitted for server replay verification in the background and a third-party time stamp is requested (the proof digest only — never the roster or draw content). Historical proofs are not uploaded automatically; you can upload them manually on the verification website. Each proof commits a digest of the record-id-to-name mapping of the roster it used, so editing the list afterwards is detectable too. It does not prove that the local program, random seed, or roster was unchanged before the draw, nor rule out filtering the roster before drawing

data.name: M_ModeConfirmLocal
data.value:
Ordinary mode draws locally immediately, works offline, and saves a replayable proof. When online, the app submits one replay-signing request to fair.sectl.cn in the background only for each newly completed ordinary draw and requests a third-party time stamp (the proof digest only — never the roster or draw content). Offline or failed historical proofs are not uploaded automatically.
Each proof commits a digest of the "record id to name/number/group" mapping of the roster it used, so editing the list afterwards to point a winning record at someone else is detectable.
It cannot prove that the local program, real roster, or random seed was unchanged before the draw, nor rule out repeated trials and selection before the draw, or filtering the roster before drawing

data.name: M_ModeConfirmFormal
data.value:
Formal notarization first locks this anonymous candidate pool, weights, and rules at fair.sectl.cn; the server then generates random material, calculates the final result, and saves an immutable official proof.
If network instability, disconnection, service unavailability, device failure, or force majeure prevents a completed server proof, no local substitute is generated and ordinary mode is not used automatically. After the server confirms the lock, the candidate pool, weights, rules, random material, and result cannot be replaced, supplemented, or recalculated in the same flow. A new draw is a separate notarization.
This prevents replacement of local draw code, random seeds, or result files during the locked flow, but cannot prove that the real roster is complete and authentic or that the pool was not manually filtered before submission
